nodes.long_description:
The Ultimate Pin-Pulling Puzzle Experience in Virtual Reality!

Step into an immersive 3D dungeon and rediscover the legendary hero-rescue fun like never before. Hero Rescue: Pull The Pin brings the viral logic gameplay into a stunning virtual setting, where every pin you pull feels impactful and every drop of treasure is a step toward mastery.

Take control of your strategy with precise aiming using your controllers. Watch as you navigate a trap-filled universe, bypassing lava and monsters to guide gold safely to your hero. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing brain-teaser or a strategic physics challenge, this game offers endless levels to test your problem-solving skills.

Game Features:

Classic Logic Gameplay, Reimagined for VR: Enjoy the familiar pin-pulling mechanics with the added depth and immersion of a virtual reality environment.

Intuitive Controller Interactions: Grab and pull pins with precision using your VR controllers for a natural and engaging puzzle-solving experience.

Stunning Dungeon Environments: Play amidst glowing lava, dark corridors, and sparkling treasures, creating a truly captivating atmosphere.

Endless Strategic Levels: Master the order and physics of every pull to defeat enemies and earn higher scores without putting the hero in danger.

Save the Princess Mode: Face special challenges where you must clear a safe path to rescue the princess from high-stakes traps.

Immersive Visuals and Sound: Experience crisp HD graphics and atmospheric audi
nodes.short_description: The ultimate logic-based rescue mission in VR! Experience the classic puzzle thrill in Hero Rescue: Pull The Pin. Aim, pull the pins, and navigate through dangerous dungeons to save the hero and collect hidden treasures. With intuitive controller-based interactions and endless levels of physics-based puzzle fun, master the art of the perfect pull and rescue the princess from the dragon's lair!

nodes.long_description: Η απόλυτη εμπειρία παζλ pin-pulling στο VR! Χαρακτηριστικά: Κλασική λογική με βάθος VR, διαισθητικός χειρισμός και λειτουργία Διάσωσης της Πριγκίπισσας.
nodes.short_description: Η απόλυτη αποστολή διάσωσης βασισμένη στη λογική στο VR! Στοχεύστε, τραβήξτε τις περόνες και σώστε τον ήρωα συλλέγοντας κρυμμένους θησαυρούς.

nodes.long_description: バーチャルリアリティでの究極のピン抜きパズル体験！特徴：VRで再現された定番のロジックパズル、直感的な操作、そしてプリンセス救出モード。
nodes.short_description: VRで楽しむ究極のピン抜きパズル救出ミッション！ピンを抜いて危険なダンジョンを攻略し、ヒーローを救って宝物を集めよう。

nodes.short_description: Die ultimative logikbasierte Rettungsmission in VR! Zielen Sie, ziehen Sie die Stifte und retten Sie den Helden in gefährlichen Kerkern voller Schätze.

nodes.short_description: VR에서 즐기는 최고의 논리 기반 구출 미ッション! 핀을 뽑고 위험한 던전을 통과하여 영웅을 구하고 숨겨진 보물을 수집하세요.
